<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem</title>
  
  <style>
    .bold-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 18px; fill: #1e293b; }
    .label-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #334155; }
    .eq-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 24px; fill: #0f172a; }
    
    @keyframes pulseA {
      0%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.35; stroke-width: 2; }
      20%, 40% { fill-opacity: 0.75; stroke-width: 4; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseB {
      40%, 60% { fill-opacity: 0.75; stroke-width: 4; }
      0%, 20%, 80%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.35; stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    @keyframes pulseC {
      60%, 80% { fill-opacity: 0.75; stroke-width: 4; }
      0%, 40%, 100% { fill-opacity: 0.35; stroke-width: 2; }
    }
    @keyframes highlightEq {
      60%, 90% { transform: scale(1.05); fill: #1d4ed8; }
      0%, 40%, 100% { transform: scale(1); fill: #0f172a; }
    }
    
    .sq-a { animation: pulseA 6s infinite; }
    .sq-b { animation: pulseB 6s infinite; }
    .sq-c { animation: pulseC 6s infinite; }
    .eq-box { transform-origin: 580px 420px; animation: highlightEq 6s infinite; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Title / Header -->
  <text x="400" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text" font-size="22">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  
  <!-- Triangle Coordinates: 
       A = (250, 320) [Right angle corner]
       B = (250, 140) [Vertical top, length 3 units -> scaled by 40px = 120px]
       C = (410, 320) [Horizontal right, length 4 units -> scaled by 40px = 160px]
       Hypotenuse = 5 units -> 200px
       Let's use scale: 1 unit = 42px
       A: (260, 330)
       B (top): (260, 330 - 3*42) = (260, 204) -> Height = 126px
       C (right): (260 + 4*42, 330) = (428, 330) -> Base = 168px
  -->

  <!-- Squares constructed on sides -->
  
  <!-- Square on side 'a' (vertical, length 3 -> 126px leftwards) -->
  <rect x="134" y="204" width="126" height="126" fill="#60a5fa" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2" class="sq-a"/>
  <!-- Grid lines for a^2 (area 9) -->
  <line x1="176" y1="204" x2="176" y2="330" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="218" y1="204" x2="218" y2="330" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="134" y1="246" x2="260" y2="246" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="134" y1="288" x2="260" y2="288" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-dasharray="4"/>

  <!-- Square on side 'b' (horizontal, length 4 -> 168px downwards) -->
  <rect x="260" y="330" width="168" height="168" fill="#34d399" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2" class="sq-b"/>
  <!-- Grid lines for b^2 (area 16) -->
  <line x1="302" y1="330" x2="302" y2="498" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="330" x2="344" y2="498" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="386" y1="330" x2="386" y2="498" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="372" x2="428" y2="372" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="414" x2="428" y2="414" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="456" x2="428" y2="456" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-dasharray="4"/>

  <!-- Square on hypotenuse 'c' (length 5 -> 210px outwards-up-left)
       Vector of hypotenuse from (428, 330) to (260, 204) is dx = -168, dy = -126.
       Perpendicular outward vector (rotated 90 deg counter-clockwise / left of vector):
       dx_perp = -dy = 126, dy_perp = dx = -168.
       Magnitude = 210. Normalised perp = (126/210, -168/210) = (0.6, -0.8).
       Corner 1: (428, 330) + (126, -168) = (554, 162)
       Corner 2: (260, 204) + (126, -168) = (386, 36)
  -->
  <polygon points="260,204 428,330 554,162 386,36" fill="#f47f54" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2" class="sq-c" fill-opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Triangle proper (drawn on top of squares for clarity) -->
  <polygon points="260,204 260,330 428,330" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Right angle symbol -->
  <rect x="260" y="310" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Labels inside/near squares -->
  <text x="197" y="271" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text">a²</text>
  <text x="175" y="295" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#64748b">(9)</text>

  <text x="344" y="418" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text">b²</text>
  <text x="344" y="442" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#64748b">(16)</text>

  <text x="430" y="185" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text">c²</text>
  <text x="430" y="208" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" fill="#64748b">(25)</text>

  <!-- Side length labels -->
  <text x="235" y="270" text-anchor="end" class="bold-text" fill="#2563eb">a = 3</text>
  <text x="344" y="322" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text" fill="#059669">b = 4</text>
  
  <!-- Hypotenuse label -->
  <text x="360" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text" fill="#d97706" transform="rotate(-37, 360, 250)">c = 5 (hypotenuse)</text>

  <!-- Explanation Panel / Box on the right -->
  <rect x="470" y="80" width="300" height="380" rx="10" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <text x="620" y="120" text-anchor="middle" class="bold-text">Key Facts</text>
  
  <text x="490" y="160" class="label-text">• Right-angled triangle has</text>
  <text x="510" y="185" class="label-text">an angle of 90°.</text>
  
  <text x="490" y="225" class="label-text">• The <tspan fill="#d97706" font-weight="bold">hypotenuse</tspan> is the</text>
  <text x="510" y="250" class="label-text">longest side, opposite</text>
  <text x="510" y="275" class="label-text">the right angle.</text>

  <text x="490" y="315" class="label-text">• Area of square <tspan fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold">a²</tspan> = 9</text>
  <text x="490" y="345" class="label-text">• Area of square <tspan fill="#059669" font-weight="bold">b²</tspan> = 16</text>
  <text x="490" y="375" class="label-text">• Area of square <tspan fill="#d97706" font-weight="bold">c²</tspan> = 25</text>

  <!-- Highlight Equation box -->
  <g class="eq-box">
    <rect x="500" y="400" width="240" height="45" rx="8" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="620" y="429" text-anchor="middle" class="eq-text">a² + b² = c²</text>
  </g>
  <text x="620" y="470" text-anchor="middle" class="label-text" font-size="14" fill="#64748b">9 + 16 = 25</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .title-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .body-text { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #334155; }
    .bold-text { font-weight: bold; }
    .label-box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1.5; rx: 6; ry: 6; }
    
    /* Animations */
    @keyframes sweep {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { r: 6px; fill: #dc2626; }
      50% { r: 9px; fill: #ef4444; }
    }
    .rotating-radius {
      transform-origin: 340px 250px;
      animation: sweep 8s linear infinite;
    }
    .centre-dot {
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="38" class="title-text">Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- Definitions / Info Panel on Right -->
  <g transform="translate(530, 70)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="250" height="400" class="label-box"/>
    
    <text x="15" y="30" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#0f172a">Key Terms:</text>
    
    <!-- Centre info -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="65" r="5" fill="#dc2626"/>
    <text x="40" y="70" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#dc2626">centre</text>
    <text x="15" y="92" class="body-text" font-size="13px">Fixed point in the</text>
    <text x="15" y="110" class="body-text" font-size="13px">middle of the circle.</text>

    <!-- Radius info -->
    <line x1="15" y1="140" x2="35" y2="140" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="45" y="145" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#0284c7">radius</text>
    <text x="15" y="167" class="body-text" font-size="13px">Centre to the edge.</text>

    <!-- Diameter info -->
    <line x1="15" y1="205" x2="35" y2="205" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="45" y="210" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#16a34a">diameter</text>
    <text x="15" y="232" class="body-text" font-size="13px">Across through centre.</text>
    <text x="15" y="255" class="body-text bold-text" font-size="13.5px" fill="#16a34a">diameter = 2 × radius</text>

    <!-- Circumference info -->
    <path d="M 15 295 Q 25 285 35 295" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
    <text x="45" y="300" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#9333ea">circumference</text>
    <text x="15" y="322" class="body-text" font-size="13px">Distance all the way</text>
    <text x="15" y="340" class="body-text" font-size="13px">around the edge.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- CIRCLE GRAPHIC AREA -->
  <!-- Outer Circumference Path (dashed highlight for animation) -->
  <circle cx="340" cy="250" r="160" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="250" r="160" fill="none" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="1004" stroke-dashoffset="1004">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="1004;0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Diameter Line (Green) -->
  <line x1="180" y1="250" x2="500" y2="250" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>
  
  <!-- Rotating Radius (Cyan) -->
  <g class="rotating-radius">
    <line x1="340" y1="250" x2="500" y2="250" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- Little dot traveling at the end of the radius -->
    <circle cx="500" cy="250" r="5" fill="#0284c7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Centre Point -->
  <circle cx="340" cy="250" r="6" class="centre-dot"/>

  <!-- LABELS ON THE DIAGRAM -->
  
  <!-- Centre Label -->
  <text x="320" y="235" class="body-text bold-text" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="end">centre</text>
  <line x1="325" y1="240" x2="335" y2="246" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Radius Label (positioned dynamically near the rotating arm) -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 215)">
    <rect x="-35" y="-14" width="70" height="24" class="label-box"/>
    <text x="0" y="2" class="body-text bold-text" font-size="14px" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">radius</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Diameter Label -->
  <g transform="translate(340, 285)">
    <rect x="-45" y="-12" width="90" height="24" class="label-box"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" class="body-text bold-text" font-size="14px" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle">diameter</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Circumference Label with pointer line -->
  <path d="M 453 137 L 490 110" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g transform="translate(495, 95)">
    <rect x="-55" y="-14" width="110" height="26" class="label-box"/>
    <text x="0" y="3" class="body-text bold-text" font-size="13px" fill="#9333ea" text-anchor="middle">circumference</text>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit GCSE Physics Diagram</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; font-weight: bold; }
    .sublabel { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8px; }
    .electron { fill: #2563eb; }
    .reading { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #2563eb; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; }
    .volt-reading { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #dc2626; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg"/>

  <!-- Title Area -->
  <text x="400" y="35" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Series Circuit: Current & Voltage</text>
  <text x="400" y="55" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">One single loop • Current is the same everywhere • Voltage is shared</text>

  <!-- Explanation Boxes -->
  <rect x="530" y="80" width="245" height="185" class="box"/>
  <text x="652" y="108" class="label" font-size="15">Key Rules</text>
  <text x="545" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">• <tspan font-weight="bold">Current:</tspan> Same at all points</text>
  <text x="555" y="155" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b">I₁ = I₂ = I₃ (e.g. 0.2 A)</text>
  <text x="545" y="190" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">• <tspan font-weight="bold">Voltage:</tspan> Shared across components</text>
  <text x="555" y="210" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b">V_cell = V₁ + V₂</text>
  <text x="555" y="230" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b">6V = 3V + 3V</text>

  <!-- CIRCUIT WIRE PATH: Rectangular Loop from x=100 to x=480, y=100 to y=420 -->
  <rect x="100" y="100" width="380" height="320" rx="10" class="wire"/>

  <!-- COMPONENTS -->

  <!-- Cell (Top wire, around x=290, y=100) -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 85)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="60" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <!-- Cell lines (Long, Short, Long, Short) -->
    <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="10" y2="25" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="10" x2="20" y2="20" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="5" x2="30" y2="25" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="10" x2="40" y2="20" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="25" y="-3" class="label" font-size="13">Cell</text>
    <text x="25" y="40" class="volt-reading">6 V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ammeter 1 (Top Left, x=180, y=100) -->
  <g transform="translate(180, 100)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="16">A</text>
    <text x="0" y="-24" class="reading">0.2 A</text>
    <text x="0" y="32" class="sublabel">current</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 1 (Right vertical wire, x=480, y=200) -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 200)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Cross inside lamp -->
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="40" y="5" class="label" font-size="14">Lamp 1</text>
    <text x="40" y="22" class="volt-reading">3 V</text>
    <!-- Voltmeter parallel bridge 1 -->
    <path d="M 0,-22 L 0,-50 L 70,-50 L 70,0 L 48,0" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="-25" r="15" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="-20" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">V</text>
    <text x="95" y="-21" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#dc2626">3V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Lamp 2 (Right vertical wire, x=480, y=340) -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 340)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Cross inside lamp -->
    <line x1="-15" y1="-15" x2="15" y2="15" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="-15" y1="15" x2="15" y2="-15" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="40" y="5" class="label" font-size="14">Lamp 2</text>
    <text x="40" y="22" class="volt-reading">3 V</text>
    <!-- Voltmeter parallel bridge 2 -->
    <path d="M 0,-22 L 0,-50 L 70,-50 L 70,0 L 48,0" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="-25" r="15" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="-20" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">V</text>
    <text x="95" y="-21" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#dc2626">3V</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Ammeter 2 (Bottom wire, x=280, y=420) -->
  <g transform="translate(280, 420)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="16">A</text>
    <text x="0" y="32" class="reading">0.2 A</text>
    <text x="0" y="47" class="sublabel">current</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ANIMATED ELECTRONS (Flowing clockwise around the loop perimeter: total length = 2*(380+320) = 1400px) -->
  <!-- Perimeter path definition: M 100 100 h 380 v 320 h -380 z -->
  
  <g>
    <!-- Electron 1 -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" class="electron">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M 100 100 h 380 v 320 h -380 z"/>
    </circle>
    <!-- Electron 2 -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" class="electron">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M 100 100 h 380 v 320 h -380 z"/>
    </circle>
    <!-- Electron 3 -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" class="electron">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-3.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M 100 100 h 380 v 320 h -380 z"/>
    </circle>
    <!-- Electron 4 -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" class="electron">
      <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M 100 100 h 380 v 320 h -380 z"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Legend for animation -->
  <circle cx="550" cy="450" r="5" class="electron"/>
  <text x="565" y="454" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">Flow of charge (current)</text>

  <line x1="535" y1="415" x2="560" y2="415" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
  <text x="565" y="419" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">Voltmeter (measures voltage)</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis in Plants</title>
  
  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { r: 35px; opacity: 0.8; }
      50% { r: 45px; opacity: 0.3; }
      100% { r: 35px; opacity: 0.8; }
    }
    @keyframes flow-co2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(130px, 120px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes flow-light {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(140px, 90px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes flow-water {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(0, -110px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes flow-oxygen {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(140px, -80px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes flow-glucose {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(110px, 90px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    .sun-glow {
      animation: pulse 3s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc"/>

  <path d="M 400 420 Q 400 440 390 460" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Leaf -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 240)">

  </g>

  <!-- ARROWS & FLOWS -->

  <!-- 1. Carbon Dioxide (from top left) -->

  <text x="210" y="145" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="end">(from air)</text>

  <!-- 2. Light Energy (from Sun to leaf) -->

  <!-- 3. Water (from roots up) -->

  <polygon points="370,260 361,268 372,271" fill="#0ea5e9"/>
  <g>

  <text x="245" y="400" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">(from soil)</text>

  <!-- 4. Oxygen (leaving leaf to top right) -->
  <path d="M 430 215 Q 500 160 580 120" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4" fill="none"/>
  <polygon points="580,120 568,121 573,131" fill="#10b981"/>
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#059669">
      <animateMotion path="M 430 215 Q 500 160 580 120" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <text x="590" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#047857" text-anchor="start">oxygen</text>
  <text x="590" y="135" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#10b981" text-anchor="start">(released)</text>

  <!-- 5. Glucose (leaving leaf to lower right) -->
  <path d="M 435 240 Q 500 270 570 310" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4" fill="none"/>
  <polygon points="570,310 560,302 560,314" fill="#f97316"/>
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#ea580c">
      <animateMotion path="M 435 240 Q 500 270 570 310" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>
  <text x="580" y="315" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c" text-anchor="start">glucose</text>
  <text x="580" y="335" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#f97316" text-anchor="start">(stored / food)</text>

  <!-- WORD EQUATION PANEL -->
  <rect x="150" y="420" width="500" height="55" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="400" y="442" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">WORD EQUATION</text>
  <text x="400" y="463" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">
    <tspan fill="#334155">carbon dioxide</tspan> + <tspan fill="#0369a1">water</tspan> 
    <tspan fill="#ca8a04"> (light) </tspan>→ 
    <tspan fill="#c2410c">glucose</tspan> + <tspan fill="#047857">oxygen</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Title banner -->
  <text x="400" y="35" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>
</svg>
